questions.question: Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statement to be true even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. Statements: Some quadrilateral are squares. All squares are rhombuses. Conclusions: I. No quadrilateral is a rhombus. II. All rhombuses are squares. III. Some quadrilaterals are rhombuses.
questions.questionHtml:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statement to be true even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some quadrilateral are squares.

All squares are rhombuses.

Conclusions:

I. No quadrilateral is a rhombus.

II. All rhombuses are squares.

III. Some quadrilaterals are rhombuses.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

Conclusions:

I. No quadrilateral is a rhombus. → False (some quadrilaterals are squares and all squares are rhombuses)

II. All rhombuses are squares. → False (it is possible but not definite)

III. Some quadrilaterals are rhombuses. → True (some quadrilaterals are squares and all squares are rhombuses)

Hence, only conclusion III follows.

questions.question: If the word ANGEL is coded as BOHFM, then what will be the third alphabet in the code for the word SAVAGE?

questions.solution:
ANGEL: A + 1 → B; N + 1 → O; G + 1 → H; E + 1 → F; L + 1 → M

Similarly

SAVAGE: S + 1 → T; A + 1 → B; V + 1 → W; A + 1 → B; G + 1 → H; E + 1 → F

Thus, the code for SAVAGE is ABWBHF.

Third alphabet of ABWBHF = W.

Hence, ‘W’ is the correct answer.

Time = \(1\frac{1}{4}\) years = [5/4] × 12 = 15 months

Rate = 8% annum

If the interest is compounded 5 monthly, then

Time = 15/5 = 3

Rate = [8/12] × 5 = [10/3]%

As we know,

Amount = P [1 + (r/100)]

A = 8100 × (31/30) × (31/30) × (31/30) = 8937.3

∴ Interest = A – P = 8937.3 – 8100 = 837.3

questions.question: By how much percentage above the cost price should an article be marked up for sale so that after allowing two successive discounts of 20% and 6.25% on it, a net gain of 20% is made on the cost?

questions.solution:
We can write, 20% = 1/5 and 6.25 = 1/16

Let the marked price of the article be 100x.

SP of the article after two successive discounts = 100x × [4/5] × [15/16] = 75x

∵ Net gain of 20% is made on the CP

⇒ CP of the article = 75x × (100/120) = 62.5x

MP is more than CP by = 100x – 62.5x = 37.5x

∴ Required percentage = [37.5/62.5] × 100 = 60%

⇒ AB = 5 cm, and CD = 11 cm

Let ON be x cm and radius OB = OD = r cm

In ΔOND

⇒ (OD)2 = (ND)2 + (ON)2                     [By Pythagoras theorem]

⇒ r2 = (11/2)2 + (x)2

questions.question: A journey of 96 km takes one hour less by a fast train (A) than by a slow train (B). If the average speed of B is 16 km/h less than that of A, then the average speed (in km/h) of A is:
questions.questionHtml: A journey of 96 km takes one hour less by a fast train (A) than by a slow train (B). If the average speed of B is 16 km/h less than that of A, then the average speed (in km/h) of A is:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Let Speed of A be x km/h. Speed of B = (x − 16) km/h.

Use formula: Difference in Time = (Distance × Difference in Speed) ÷ (Product of Speeds).

1 = (96 × 16) ÷ (x × (x − 16))

x(x − 16) = 1536. Testing options: 48 × (48 − 16) = 48 × 32 = 1536.

∴ The correct answer is 48 km/h.

Alternate Method

Given: Total Distance = 96 km, Time Difference = 1 hour, Speed of B = Speed of A − 16 km/h.

Formula: Time = Distance ÷ Speed

⇒ Time taken by B − Time taken by A = 1

⇒ [96 ÷ (x − 16)] − [96 ÷ x] = 1

⇒ 96 [ (x − (x − 16)) ÷ (x(x − 16)) ] = 1

⇒ 96 [ 16 ÷ (x2 − 16x) ] = 1

⇒ x2 − 16x − 1536 = 0

⇒ x2 − 48x + 32x − 1536 = 0

⇒ x(x − 48) + 32(x − 48) = 0

⇒ (x − 48)(x + 32) = 0

⇒ x = 48 (Since speed cannot be negative)

∴ The correct answer is 48 km/h.

Additional Information

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, relative speed is the difference (S1 − S2); in opposite directions, it is the sum (S1 + S2).

Average Speed Formula

If a journey covers equal distances at speeds u and v, the average speed is (2 × u × v) ÷ (u + v).

Speed-Time Relation

For a constant distance, speed is inversely proportional to time. Ratio of speeds S1:S2 = Ratio of times T2:T1.

When the difference is 0.24, CP = Rs. 100

When the difference is 9, CP = 100 × 9/0.24 = Rs. 3750

Hence the cost price of the article is Rs. 3750.

Therefore, the order will be CBAD and the correct option is option 2.

The conjunction 'while' is the correct word to combine these two ideas and clauses together. It is used to combine two actions that are happening at the same time.

Now, the verb in the second clause will be in its -ing form after the conjunction 'while'.
